mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodation_sub_img (acm_id, sub_img_name, content) VALUES (#{acm_id}, #{sub_img_name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT acm.acm_name, acm.acm_type_id, acm.address, acm.detail_address, acm.main_img, acm.admin_phone_number, acm.acm_id, acm.longitude, acm.latitude, acm.admin_id, acm.description, asi.sub_img_name, asi.content, fcl.fcl_name FROM accommodation acm LEFT JOIN accommodation_sub_img asi ON acm.acm_id = asi.acm_id LEFT JOIN provided_facilities pf ON acm.acm_id = pf.acm_id LEFT JOIN facilities fcl ON pf.fcl_id = fcl.fcl_id WHERE acm.acm_id = #{acm_id} ORDER BY asi.acm_img_no
mapper.update: UPDATE accommodation SET acm_name = #{acm_name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, acm_type_id = #{acm_type_id,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, address = #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, detail_address = #{detail_address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, main_img = #{main_img,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, admin_phone_number = #{admin_phone_number,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, longitude = #{longitude,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, latitude = #{latitude,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE acm_id = #{acm_id}
